category.instructions: Which problem does this log line report, if any?

criteria.network: connection refused or timed out, DNS failure, link down, unreachable host
criteria.auth: login, password, token or permission refused
criteria.disk: storage full, I/O error, read-only or failing disk
criteria.memory: out of memory, allocation failed, process killed for memory
criteria.crash: segfault, panic, core dump, unhandled exception, abnormal exit
criteria.config: invalid, unknown or missing setting, configuration parse error
criteria.info: no problem: a routine message such as started, connected, listening or synchronised
